description:
Every tea recipe: berries, Mixing Table slot order, buff and duration. The data behind https://rust.wiki/teas. Each tea has `name`, `shortname`, `tier` (Basic, Advanced, Pure),
`ingredients` (`item`, `qty`, `shortname`), `slot_order` / `slots` (the Mixing Table order for Basic teas -
order matters: Scrap and Warming Tea use the same berries), `effect`, `duration_minutes` and `note` (Advanced
and Pure values predate Rust's 5 Nov 2026 tea nerf). `notes` covers stacking and mixing rules. Sourced from
Facepunch's wiki and devblogs (`sources`, `verified`).

search.description: Case-insensitive match on the tea's name or effect.
